reason: We don't go first on this kind of thing. We watch what Robinhood and Coinbase do, and I'm not putting an unaudited startup with zero customers in the path of every agent trade, even for free, when my engineers already rate-limit every key.
objection: The identity check rests on AINRA passports, a registry the vendor's own founder started. That means the referee and the vendor are the same people. There's no SOC 2 yet, and I'd be the one explaining an outage or a bad approval to compliance.
would_change_my_mind: Robinhood or Coinbase, or a regulator, adopting an independent Know-Your-Agent standard that Gate supports, plus a finished SOC 2 Type II.
